honesty.day_night: In the 3D scene, time of day drives sun, sky, fog and window lights (IST). In the optional 2D MapLibre view, day/night is only a basemap style switch.
honesty.heights: 3D scene: every footprint is raised. Height sources are labelled — mapped OSM/Overture height, floors×3 m, calibrated GlobalBuildingAtlas satellite estimate, GHSL 100 m area estimate, or typed default. Estimates are never called measured. Optional 2D MapLibre extrusions still use only OSM height/floors (others stay flat).
honesty.extent: 3D bake covers roughly Sinhgad–Wagholi (see scene manifest extent_lonlat). It is not a verified full PMC∪PCMC product. Optional 2D PMTiles (if present locally) use a smaller center bbox in buildings.baked_bbox. SAMPLE admin polygons are illustrative, not official wards.
honesty.search_limits: 3D presets fly to named places from the bake. Fixture place search on the 2D map is a small demo index — not a complete POI directory.
honesty.ship_hold: Public 3D twin is a free open-data exploration build. Admin boundaries remain SAMPLE. Do not treat as an official municipal product. Full PMC/PCMC verification is not claimed.
honesty.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Building footprints © Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL), including Google Open Buildings (CC BY 4.0) and Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (ODbL). Heights: OSM tags, GlobalBuildingAtlas, GHSL where labelled. Terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-30. Ground: Sentinel-2. Trees in the 3D scene: WorldCover-driven placement (not surveyed stems). 2D basemap: OpenFreeMap / MapLibre demo. SAMPLE admin is illustrative geometry.
honesty.camera: Default view is the Three.js 3D twin. Use “2D map” for MapLibre. Flat/reset controls on the 2D map tilt buildings for OSM-known heights only.
honesty.terrain: 3D hills use Copernicus DEM (~30 m). 2D map terrain (if enabled) uses public terrarium tiles at true scale.
honesty.trees: 3D scene trees are generated from WorldCover candidates (not individual surveyed trees). On the 2D map, tree markers are OSM natural=tree only.

terrain.attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data (Mapzen; SRTM, GMTED, NED, ETOPO1 and others)
